Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4478 (bob), Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

Needs changes before merge. This is the first review of this PR.

The own commit `9351f22ec` (the move of the playback to camcraft-sim) is clean. I found no defect in it. The block comes from the stack: the branch carries #4380 at its old head `31438caa1`. That head has open review findings, and on the trial merge with the current `upstream/main` three tests of the #4380 part are red.

## What looks good

- The move is faithful. I compared each moved file with its source at `31438caa1`:
  - `play.rs`, `play_index.rs`, `play_worker.rs`, `play_worker_precalc.rs`, `play_worker_frame.rs`, `play_cut.rs` and `play_bind.rs` change only their imports, their doc paths, the seed type and the clock reads.
  - `rotary_slice.rs`, `lathe_plan.rs` and `field_view.rs` hold the same bodies as the app code that they replace.
  - The undercut unpack moved from `FieldPlay::from_seed` to `op_plan` in app. The result is the same.
- The clock seam is correct. Each `Instant::now()` / `elapsed()` became `now()` / `now().saturating_sub(t0)`. The chunk law and the publication floors do not change. camcraft-sim gets no new dependency, and app passes `clock::monotonic`, which keeps the #31 wasm32 seam.
- App keeps only the world reads (`PlaySeed::gather`, `FieldPlayWorld`). The old paths stay as re-exports. This obeys AGENTS.md "`app` holds the document, nothing else".
- The pins are unit tests in the sim lib (`play_tests.rs`). There is no new test binary. The Gate maps of the playback suites name the new sim modules.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. Each new module has a provenance line. The largest new file is 362 lines.
- `docs/decisions/2268-play-to-sim.md` records the choice, the reasons and what was dropped.

## Requested before merge

1. **Class: a stacked PR carries an old parent head. The branch must not merge before #4380, and it must be gated again on the parent's final head.**
   - The diff of this PR against `main` includes all of #4380 at `31438caa1`. The review https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4380#issuecomment-7226134531 asked for changes on that head. The fixes are on `2acc52c3e`, which this branch does not have. #4380 has `needs-rework` and `conflicts` now.
   - On the trial merge with `upstream/main`, three tests of the #4380 part fail. The same tests are on the #4380 re-review (https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4380#issuecomment-7230087384). They do not exist on bare `upstream/main`, so they are not pre-existing failures:
     - `camcraft-post --test script_goldens`: `script_fanuc::drill_full_diameter` and `script_doosan_dnm::drill_full_diameter` fail. The goldens have `G90 G54 G40 G49 G80` (Fanuc). The post now writes `G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80` after PR #4382. The drilling line `G73 X20. Y10. Z-12.803 R1. Q4. F60.` is the same in the output and in the golden.
       ```text
       assertion `left == right` failed: golden .../crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/fanuc/drill_full_diameter.nc is stale; regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1 and read the diff
       ```
     - `camcraft-ui --lib`: `egui_app::tests::holes_break_through::drill_break_through_from_is_disabled_where_it_has_no_effect` fails (1806 passed, 1 failed, 8 ignored).
   - Fix: follow AGENTS.md "Overlapping issues stack". Let #4380 get its fixes, a clean review and its merge first. Then merge `origin/main` into this branch (no rebase, no force-push). Run the quick gate again on that head. After that, the diff of this PR against `main` is only `9351f22ec` and its merge. Then ask for a fresh review. Do not change the own commit for this finding.

## Results (local, on m3, no runner)

- PR head: `9351f22ec629136a85dc073b29947ced3afc1c4d`.
- Base: `upstream/main` at `6898b02ea3195e9124e6113afd6ab3cee38d0c50`.
- Trial merge: `0f4b1584578ae245d8a55c115ac26b5e1bc634e7` (first parent is the PR head). The merge has no conflicts. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.

| Step (trial merge) | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-sim --lib` (with the three pins) | 294 passed |
| `camcraft-app` `stock_play`, `stock_play_partial`, `stock_play_precalc`, `stock_play_picture`, `stock_play_stop`, `stock_view`, `sim_op_step_stock`, `fidelity_copies` | 8, 4, 9 (1 ignored), 7, 3, 4, 2, 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app` `stock_play_cost_bench` | 0 passed, 4 ignored (bench) |
| `camcraft-app` `break_through`, `recorded_post_streams` | 12, 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app --lib` | 329 passed |
| `camcraft-motion --lib` | 769 passed, 22 ignored |
| `camcraft-post --test script_goldens` | 465 passed, **2 failed** (Requested 1) |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 1806 passed, **1 failed** (Requested 1), 8 ignored |
| `clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | **not completed**: two runs stopped at the time limit on a loaded host (other pool builds held the cache). This is not a pass. The author reports clippy clean on the PR head. |

I did not run the full quick plan (271 steps). The red steps above are enough for this verdict.

Extra suites run:

- `camcraft-app`: `example_catalog` (50 passed, 4 ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive` (1 passed), `example_catalog_edge_work` (1 passed).
- `camcraft-post`: `script_goldens`, as above.
- No file under `testdata/` and no importer code changes. Thus the kernel STEP suites do not apply.

Heavy lanes: not run. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" gives no heavy step to a P7 PR.

## Safety tier and mutations

This review uses the safety tier: the PR moves stock-simulation code. I restored each mutation. After the restore, `stock_play`, `stock_play_partial`, `stock_play_stop` and `sim_op_step_stock` passed again (17 passed).

- `op_plan` in `crates/app/src/stock_play.rs` drops the undercut (plain moves, no head/neck cutter): `stock_play::playback_removes_undercut_head_and_neck_and_matches_field_view` fails.
- `PlayInputs::index` in `crates/sim/src/play_index.rs` drops the `rest` list: `sim_op_step_stock::an_operation_without_a_toolpath_is_no_stop_and_the_stock_holds_before_it` fails.

The author's own mutation (the base `crates/sim/src/lib.rs`) makes the pins fail to compile. I did not run it again. The two mutations above check behaviour through the app suites.

## Goldens moved

The own commit changes no `.nc`, `.cl` or catalog file. The new post goldens in the diff come from #4380 (they are new, not moved). Requested 1 covers the two stale ones.

## Optional, non-blocking

- After #4380 merges, the body can drop the "Stacked on #4380" paragraph and the note on the two missing #4380 commits.

The PR waits for #4380 and a merge of main. Then it needs a fresh review of the new head.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
